author_split_protocol: Official combined DF40_all.json exact-path assignments override archive partitions; unmatched paths retain released archive train/test. Per-method held-out JSONs represent a different protocol and are not mixed into this inventory.
source_authority: Captured primary Google Drive ZIP directories and combined DF40_all.json; no image pixels included.

source_group_policy.unconditional_efs: Individual generated images with unknown identity/lineage; generation_batch is audit-only, never a must-link grouping key.
source_group_policy.native_real: Method/domain/archive-local image identifiers; numeric filenames do not prove global FFHQ/CelebA identity.
source_group_policy.conditional_fe: Only documented/explicit source identifiers are grouped, including verified FF/CDF source IDs. Generic or merely numeric edit directories do not establish source linkage.
source_group_policy.generic_e4e_inversions: Individual edited images when generic inversions folders provide no explicit source identifier; preserve verified FF/CDF and paired FE source identifiers.
source_group_policy.independence_caveat: Individual grouping does not assert distinct people. Only documented source/latent relationships or verified duplicate evidence creates links.
source_group_policy.unverified_fe: Each FE output without an explicit source identifier is an image-level unknown-lineage unit. No must-link is inferred from directories, including stargan/fake/fake and singleton CollabDiff numeric folders.
